header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH CIRCUIT COURT MIRPUR KHAS
(Qaim Ali & others V. P.O. Sindh & others)
body: 2. Through instant Petition, the petitioner seeks appointment in Departments of Government of Sindh under the 5% quota reserved for the Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) under the provisions of Sindh Empowerment of Persons With Disabilities Act, 2018 (SEPDA). It is the case of the Petitioners that they have applied for the post in BS 01 to 04 but no response as yet received. Petitioners pray to direct the Respondents to issue appointment orders to them under the quota reserved for disable persons.

3. Learned Assistant Advocate General, who is present in court in other matters waives notice and submits that the vacancies under the PWD quota stand filled, however assured that the case of the Petitioners shall be considered by the concerned head of the DRC in accordance with law. Petitioners are satisfied to such statement and seek disposal of the petition.

4. In view of above this Petition is disposed of with directions to the Respondents to expedite the recruitment process under PWD quota and redress the grievance of the Petitioners within 90 days from date of this order.
5. Office is directed to send the copy of this order to Respondents for compliance.
